CA.rationale: A is absent, so CA cannot be present.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), an explicit origin/access description, and their separation are all stated for the same p1/current/n1 referent.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking attention to the same content's organization is present.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists content coordinates (red) tied to a named referent.

D.rationale: The text separately records content identity (coordinates) and its status/origin (completed_record with timestamps) for the same referent.

O.rationale: The report specifies how the content is represented/accessed via origin kind and represented_time.
